name: actor-not-a-role
summary: A use case's actor is one of its product's roles.
explanation: This is this repo's own check. Specs name roles, never people: each product lists its roles as role rows (Lathe's are Owner, Reader and Agent), and a use case names its actors as use_case_actor rows. Change the actor to one of the product's roles, or add the role to the product and say what it does. A product with use cases but no roles is reported too.
query:
SELECT a.use_case_id AS record,
       'Use case ' || u.id || ' (' || u.title || ') names "' || a.role_name || '" as its actor, which is not one of product '
       || d.product_id || '''s roles (' || coalesce((SELECT string_agg(r.name, ', ' ORDER BY r.name) FROM role r WHERE r.product_id = d.product_id), 'none')
       || '); name a role, or add it to the product''s roles.' AS message
FROM use_case_actor a
JOIN use_case u ON u.id = a.use_case_id
JOIN record_scope d ON d.id = u.id
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM role r WHERE r.product_id = d.product_id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM role r WHERE r.product_id = d.product_id AND r.name = a.role_name)
UNION ALL
SELECT p.id, 'Product ' || p.id || ' (' || p.title || ') has use cases but no roles; list the roles its use cases name, such as Owner, Reader and Agent.'
FROM product p
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM use_case u JOIN record_scope d ON d.id = u.id WHERE d.product_id = p.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM role r WHERE r.product_id = p.id)
ORDER BY record, message
